# Meghanath Macha

Head of AI & Platform at ZeroToOne.AI. Architects behavioral foundation models and the
platforms that run them in production, including inference, identity, and data infrastructure.

- Website: https://mmacha.github.io/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/meghanathmacha/
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=XNzyEd0AAAAJ&hl=en
- Email: meghanath.macha@gmail.com
- Notes (personal short takes): https://mmacha.github.io/notes/

## Now

Leads AI and platform at ZeroToOne.AI. Builds the Large Behavioral Model, a shared foundation
model trained on sequences of physical and digital consumer behavior. In November 2026,
ZeroToOne.AI scored about 3 billion device IDs a day. The team checks model updates across product uses before release.
GroundTruth Ads Manager offers more than 1,500 predictive audience segments that refresh daily.

Built Audience Builder, an agent that turns a plain-English brief into an inspectable
audience definition. Led technical diligence on the GroundTruth and WeatherBug acquisition
and now leads platform integration. The team consolidated GroundTruth’s direct audience
delivery and preserved existing audience IDs for campaigns.

## Previously

Founding engineer on Adobe GenStudio, where he built the verification layer that ran
separately from content generation and let reviewers see which rules an asset failed.
The brand check shipped with GenStudio for Performance Marketing in October 2024. Earlier, founding ML engineer at the Carnegie Mellon
spin-out that became ZeroToOne.AI and research scientist at Adobe Research India.

## Research

Carnegie Mellon Ph.D. in privacy-preserving behavioral modeling. Published in ISR, DMKD, KDD and
Management Science. M.Sc. and B.Sc. in Mathematics and Computing from the
Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur.

## Patents

10 granted patents, 15+ filed across behavioral ML, GenAI, and privacy. First-listed inventor on
ZeroToOne.AI's WO2025006073 (modeling user predisposition from location data).

## Notes

Short takes, mostly on building AI systems: https://mmacha.github.io/notes/ (RSS: https://mmacha.github.io/notes/feed.xml)
